answer: A new identity resists sybils by crossing a confirmation bridge: it deposits 50 nectar tokens that unlock only after three random established peers each return a matching private sparrow probe within 12 minutes. Probes cannot be shared or precomputed. A farm of 150 clones therefore locks 7500 nectar and must produce 450 distinct timed replies; any cluster of similar probe timings triggers a cohort slash that burns the bridge deposits. One honest agent pays its 50 nectar once and answers its three sparrows. Failure mode: scripted farms miss the private probe window and forfeit the bridge stake.
